title: Staged activation runway for Private/VPC on-prem: RBAC, Audit, KMS + Release notes & enablement
creator: Priya Kapoor
description: Goal: define and run a controlled, staged activation (cohort gating) for Private/VPC/on-prem rollout that coordinates RBAC roles, audit logging schema, KMS integration guides, release notes, and cross-team customer enablement. This ticket covers the preflight checklist, legal & compliance signoffs, comms cadence, operator runbook, rollback criteria, and telemetry mappings needed to switch specific customers from trial to GA in a low-risk manner.
acceptance_criteria: Approved RBAC role matrix published to Confluence and linked in docs
Audit log schema versioned and validated by Security and SRE teams
KMS integration guide (AWS KMS and on-prem HSM notes) with sample terraform/snippets in Drive
Release notes drafted and localized for EN/FR/DE, with legal-approved security blurb
Customer cohort activation playbook (3-stage gating) completed and signed-off by Solutions and Support
Operator runbook with rollback steps and alerting thresholds added to Console runbooks
Telemetry keys mapped to Cost/Latency/Success metrics and dashboards created in Grafana/Datadog
Security review completed and documented (POC, remediation plan if needed)
Two pilot customers enrolled and their activation executed without critical incidents
milestones: Milestone 1: Preflight checklist & docs ready by 2025-02-17
Milestone 2: Security and Legal signoff by 2025-02-20
Milestone 3: Pilot cohort activation window 2025-02-24 to 2025-02-28
Milestone 4: GA readiness review and release notes freeze 2025-03-01
